text: Ethics in AI is becoming an important topic today. As artificial intelligence systems make more decisions in our lives, we must think about their impact on people. One major concern is bias, because AI can learn unfair patterns from the data it is trained on. This can lead to unfair treatment of certain groups, so fairness must be a key goal. Privacy is another issue, since AI often collects and uses personal information. Transparency matters too, because people should understand how AI systems make decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create clear rules and protect users.
